name: Xcode Cloud
description: Manage Xcode Cloud products, workflows, Git references, build runs, actions, issues, test results, and artifacts through the App Store Connect API. Start an existing workflow or rebuild a run. Configure the product, repository access, signing, and distribution workflow in Xcode/App Store Connect first.

credential_fields.name: issuer_id
credential_fields.label: Issuer ID
credential_fields.description: App Store Connect team API key issuer ID from Users and Access > Integrations.

credential_fields.name: key_id
credential_fields.label: Key ID
credential_fields.description: ID of a team App Store Connect API key with access to Xcode Cloud.

credential_fields.name: private_key
credential_fields.label: API Private Key (.p8)
credential_fields.description: Full AuthKey_<KEY_ID>.p8 PEM contents. The existing App Store Connect signer generates short-lived ES256 JWTs automatically.

tools.name: start_build
tools.description: Start an existing Xcode Cloud workflow for exactly one branch/tag or pull request. List Git references or pull requests first to obtain Apple resource IDs. This runs the workflow and consumes Xcode Cloud usage.

git_reference_id.description: scmGitReferences resource ID, not a branch name.

tools.name: rebuild
tools.description: Rebuild an existing Xcode Cloud run using its original workflow and source reference. This starts a new run and consumes build usage.

tools.description: Download the exact downloadUrl returned by get_artifact. Apple API signing and credentials are disabled for the artifact host.
